title: Projection maps as a morphism of strict derived towers
statement:
Let $f:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),R_X)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D),R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by small sites [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Use module-sheaf unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], derived pullback $Lf^*$ and direct image $Rf_*$ with the canonical adjunction and projection transformation $\alpha_{E,P}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Let $P_\bullet$ be a strict inverse sequence of bounded complexes of finite free $R_Y$-modules, with chain transitions $p_n:P_{n+1}\to P_n$ and compatible chain maps $z_n:R_Y[0]\to P_n$. Put $P'_\bullet=f^*P_\bullet$, with the termwise pullback, pulled-back transitions and maps $z'_n:R_X[0]\to P'_n$. For $E\in D(R_X)$ form $S_\bullet(E)=\operatorname{Tot}(N\otimes_{R_Y}P_\bullet)$ from a representative $N$ of $Rf_*E$, and $T_\bullet(E)=\operatorname{Tot}(K\otimes_{R_X}P'_\bullet)$ from a representative $K$ of $E$, using total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. These define objects of the derived categories of strict towers, independently of the representatives. Write $R f_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}$ for levelwise total derived direct image and $L_X,L_Y$ for strict total derived inverse limit [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison] [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. There is a natural morphism
$$u:S_\bullet(E)\longrightarrow R f_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}T_\bullet(E)$$
in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(R_Y))$ whose evaluation at $n$ is $\alpha_{E,P_n}$ under the canonical derived-pullback comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback]. It is natural in chain maps of the entire augmented tower $(P_\bullet,p_\bullet,z_\bullet)$. The induced map $L_Y(u)$ is a morphism of the natural Roos triangles, including the connecting square. Let $\zeta_Y:Rf_*E\to L_Y S_\bullet(E)$ and $\zeta_X:E\to L_X T_\bullet(E)$ be induced by $1\otimes z_\bullet$ and $1\otimes z'_\bullet$, using ordinary-limit coaugmentations followed by the total derived-functor comparison. For the comparison $a_{f,T}:Rf_*L_XT\xrightarrow{\sim}L_YRf_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}T$ specified in [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison], one has
$$L_Y(u)\circ\zeta_Y=a_{f,T}\circ Rf_*(\zeta_X).$$
No ideal or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Every bounded finite-free coefficient complex is K-flat and termwise flat. Pullback preserves these properties. Form the functors of total tensor diagrams in the coefficient tower and reassemble diagrams of complexes as complexes of strict towers using the existing HomologicalComplex.functorEquivalence and its counit. Lift diagram morphisms componentwise in chain degree. A quasi-isomorphism in the first variable remains a quasi-isomorphism at every level, hence in the tower category. Localize these functors to obtain S and T and their comparisons on all complex representatives.

proof.text: The mixed tensor representative is natural in its first complex variable: lift any morphism to a common pullback refinement of K-flat resolutions, using an epimorphic K-flat resolution, and cancel the localized quasi-isomorphisms. Descend this natural isomorphism along Q. Compose with the normalized tower evaluation comparison to construct sEv and tEv. K-flat coefficients compute derived pullback, so the X-side comparison includes the prescribed derived-pullback map. This proves the representative normalization and naturality clauses.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: The ordinary adjunction and its tensor comparison give a natural chain projection mate. Use the existing proved total-pullback naturality and projection summand lemmas; the direct-sum universal property gives a natural total pullback comparison. Thus the chain mate is natural in both variables and defines a morphism of the entire coefficient tower, before localization. Its tensor-unit equation follows from the ordinary projection mate unit equation, checked on the summands of total tensor.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: Compose the localized strict chain mate with the total-derived tower direct-image comparison. The comparison from underived direct image to derived direct image is invertible on the functorial K-injective resolution of the first variable. Use that resolution and naturality to invert this comparison and descend the resulting natural transformation along Q. This constructs u simultaneously natural in the derived object and in the augmented coefficient tower, with its normalized lifting equation on every complex.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: Extend the normalized compatibility between evaluation and tower direct image from K-injective tower complexes to all tower complexes using their functorial K-injective resolutions; evaluation preserves quasi-isomorphisms. The tower category is Grothendieck abelian by the small module-diagram theorem and equivalence of the lifted indexing categories. On K-injective first-variable representatives, the totalization-left equation identifies the chain mate with the canonical derived projection mate after canceling its isomorphisms. Keep the totalization equation in its original representative form and perform the identity-isomorphism simplifications and comparison transports in generic categories. Combine the evaluation, representative, and lifting naturality squares, cancel the direct-image comparison and the evaluation isomorphisms, and descend along Q. The evaluated components of u are exactly the prescribed projection transformation.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: Use the tensor right unitor and the compatible coefficient augmentations to obtain maps from the constant complex into the ordinary inverse limits of both strict tensor towers. Their degreewise projections are precisely the required coaugmentations. Compose their localizations with the total-derived-limit comparison and descend to obtain zetaY and zetaX with the stated normalization on arbitrary representatives.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: Coefficient naturality and the chain mate unit equation give the coaugmentation square at every tower level. The ordinary limit comparison, normalized as limit.post, transports this square through ordinary limits. Combine it with the normalized common-underived direct-image/limit comparison and the lifting equation for u, first on functorial K-injective representatives and then by localization. This gives the asserted zeta compatibility on every derived object without a constant-tower K-injectivity argument.

source.place: Tags 0943 and 0A07; augmented strict-tower compatibility used in algebraization.tex Tag 0A0G

proof.text: Apply naturality of the first Roos map and connecting morphism to each component of u. Naturality of its evaluated tower morphism gives the middle transition-endomorphism square. These are the three required squares of Roos triangles.
